settings.guideHtml:
By quill and ink: Overview
  • By quill and ink: Start page with search, favorites, to-do, notes, weather, news.
  • By quill and ink: All local: data stays in your browser (localStorage).
By quill and ink: Shortcuts
  • By quill and ink: Ctrl/Cmd+K: open command palette
  • By quill and ink: 1-9: open first 9 favorites (when not typing)
  • By quill and ink: / : focus search (also via palette)
  • By quill and ink: Enter in search: start search
  • By quill and ink: ESC: close modals
  • By quill and ink: Palette: quick actions for widgets, theme, background, data, favorites
  • By quill and ink: Palette: key C switches card style, "Reset header colors" resets search & clock
By quill and ink: Search & Autocomplete
  • By quill and ink: Bangs: !gBy quill and ink: !ddgBy quill and ink: !bingBy quill and ink: !ytBy quill and ink: !wikiBy quill and ink: !maps
  • By quill and ink: Custom shortcuts: JSON in settings; {q}By quill and ink: as placeholder
  • By quill and ink: Autocomplete: bangs, shortcuts, recent searches, wordlist (global + preset)
  • By quill and ink: Tab accepts suggestion, Enter starts search
By quill and ink: Tiles
  • By quill and ink: Drag & drop to sort, click to open
  • By quill and ink: + Tile: add a new favorite
  • By quill and ink: Reset: restore default favorites
By quill and ink: Widgets & Layout
  • By quill and ink: Visibility per widget
  • By quill and ink: Card style is global (glass, solid, transparent, soft minimal)
  • By quill and ink: Custom colors for clock/search; reset restores style defaults
  • By quill and ink: Widget colors & "Tint widgets" set the accent per card
By quill and ink: Background
  • By quill and ink: Presets, uploads, collections, rotation (time/theme/interval)
  • By quill and ink: Accent color is extracted from the active background
By quill and ink: Data
  • By quill and ink: Export/Import as JSON
  • By quill and ink: Load data presets (assets/presets/*.json in the repo)
Startpage Agent
  • Integrated AI chat with local Ollama (host/model in settings).
  • Supports streaming responses, stop (button/ESC), persistent history, and Markdown.
  • Agentic tools can read/change widgets and settings (depending on confirm mode).
